title: Profile safe low-cost glyph micro-ops and logical context parallelism

reason.question: Can receive-time LLM effort be reduced by selecting only empirically cheap local operations and batching independent glyph operations in context?

before.native_probe: model decodes each glyph directly to byte stream

critical_caveat: Black-box model internal FLOPs are not observable or controllable; optimization is empirical using accuracy, latency, token, retry and cost proxies.
